questions.question: If x + y = 4, xy = 2, y + z = 5, yz = 3, z + x = 6 and zx = 4, then find the value of x³ + y³ + z³ — 3xyz.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** x + y = 4, y + z = 5, z + x = 6

So,

x + y + z = 15/2 = 7.5

We know that 

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) × [(x + y + z)2 – 3(xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ 7.5 × [7.5² - 3(2 + 3 + 4)]

**Given :**

**Calculations :**

x + y = 4, y + z = 5, z + x = 6

So,

x + y + z = 15/2 = 7.5

questions.question: Find the value of (cos 30^circ - sin 30^circ)/(sin 60^circ + cos 60^circ)
questions.solution:
**Given :**

(cos 30° - sin 30°)/(sin 60° + cos 60°) 

**Formula used :**

Cos 30° = sin 60° = √3/2

cos 60° = sin 30° = 1/2 

**Calculations :**

Putting all values in the equation 

[(√3/2) - (1/2)]/[(√3/2) + (1/2)] 

⇒ (√3 - 1)/(√3 + 1)

Now rationalising 

⇒ [(√3 - 1)/(√3 + 1)] × [(√3 - 1)/(√3 - 1)]

⇒ (√3 - 1)²/2 

⇒ (3 + 1 - 2√3)/2 

⇒ (4 - 2√3)/2 

⇒ 2 - √3 

**∴ Option 1 will be the correct answer.**

questions.question: A batsman in his 11th innings makes a score of 77 runs, thereby increasing his average scores by 3. What is his average score after the 11th inning?
questions.solution:
**Given :
**

A batsman in his 11th innings makes a score of 77 runs, thereby increasing his average scores by 3.

**Formula used :**

Average = Total value of all observations/Number of observations 

**Calculations :**

Let the average score per match up to 10 matches be 'x' 

Total score up to 10 matches = 10 × x = 10x 

Total score up to 11 matches = 10x + 77 

Now according to the question 

(10x + 77)/11 = x + 3 

⇒ 10x + 77 = 11x + 33 

⇒ x = 44 

Average score after 11th innings = x + 3 

⇒ 44 + 3 

⇒ 47 

**∴ His average after 11th innings will be 47 runs **

questions.question: If a³ + b³ = 20 and a + b = 5, then find the value of a⁴ + b⁴
questions.solution:
**Given :**

a + b = 5 and a³ + b³ = 20

**Formula used :**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

(a² + b²)² = a⁴ + b⁴ + 2a²b²

**Calculations :**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

5³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(5)

⇒ 3ab(5) = 125 – 20

⇒ ab = 7

Now,

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ 5² = a² + b² + 2 × 7

⇒ a² + b² = 25 – 14 = 11

So,

(a² + b²)² = a⁴ + b⁴ + 2a²b²

11² = a⁴ + b⁴ + 2 × 49

⇒ a⁴ + b⁴ = 121 – 98

⇒ 23

**∴ The value of a⁴ + b⁴ is equal to 23.**

questions.question: A 5 cm long perpendicular is drawn from the centre of a circle to a 24 cm long chord. Find the diameter of the circle.
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A 5 cm long perpendicular is drawn from the centre of a circle to a 24 cm long chord

**Concept used :**

The line is drawn from the centre of a circle towards a chord always divides the chord in two equal parts and also perpendicular to the chord. 

**Calculations :**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/564ad8315103fc5cab6fad0559354afef99ee059cfd6300576ec26b6207368cd.png] **

Let the centre of the circle be 'O' and 'OC' is the radius 

Let the chord be 'AB' where 'M' is the midpoint of the chord.

Length of chord AC is 24 cm so MC is equal to 12 cm

Now according to the question 

OC² = OM² + MC²

OC² = 5² + 12²

OC² = 25 + 144 

OC² = 169 

⇒ OC = √169 

⇒ 13 

Now, 

Diameter of the circle = 2 × Radius 

⇒ 2 × 13 

⇒ 26 cm 

**∴ The diameter of the circle is 26 cm.**

questions.question: A man walks from point X to Y at a speed of 20 km/h, but comes back from point Y to X at a speed of 25 km/h. Find his average speed.
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A man walks from point X to Y at a speed of 20 km/h, but comes back from point Y to X at a speed of 25 km/h.

**Concept used :**

Average speed = Total Distance/Total time taken 

**Calculations :**

Let the distance from X to Y be 'D' 

Total distance = D + D = 2D 

Time taken = (D/20) + (D/25) (time = distance/speed) 

⇒ (9D/100) 

Average speed = (2D)/(9D/100)

⇒ 200/9 

⇒ 22(2/9) km/h 

**∴ The average speed will be 22(2/9) km/h **
